family: MOD3-zero family, defined in proof.md Section 1: L is the set of all binary strings x (including the empty string) whose number of 1-bits is divisible by 3. For every integer n>=0, f_n:{0,1}^n->{0,1} is f_n(x)=1 iff x_1+...+x_n is congruent to 0 modulo 3 (so f_0=1). One fixed linear-time evaluator computes f_n at every length; the NP verifier V(x,w)=1 iff w is empty and f_|x|(x)=1, with witness bound W=0.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family (hence in NP with empty witnesses), C_B2(f_n)>=2n-6 for every integer n>=3 in the full Li–Yang B2 model (all 16 binary gate types, unrestricted fan-out and depth, constant nodes free, every retained gate counted), with n=|x| the actual input length. Hence liminf over all integers n of C_B2(f_n)/n >= 2.
